blocks.text: Angeline Quinto credited her husband, Nonrev Daquina, for helping her become more mindful of her finances as they ventured into business together for the first time as a married couple. During a recent contract signing with a salon, where the couple is set to open a franchise in Angeles, Pampanga, Quinto shared that Daquina takes charge of budgeting and keeping track of their money. “‘Yung asawa ko kasi talaga, bago pa kami nagkakilala, may mga business na talaga siyang inumpisahan. And, honestly po, kung sa paghahawak talaga ng budget, paghahawak ng pera, mas magaling siya sa akin. Mas masinop,” she said. […]...
